summary: Adds bearer-token auth middleware and wires it into the widget routes.

concerns.title: New auth middleware
concerns.description: Reviews the new `requireAuth` middleware: token validation, the public-path allowlist, and error handling on failure.

concerns.title: Widget routes now require auth
concerns.description:
The new middleware needs to be wired into the widget routes correctly.

- `GET /widgets` and `POST /widgets` now require a valid bearer token
- A new `DELETE /widgets/:id` route was added, also gated behind `requireAuth`
- Check that the 401 response shape matches what the frontend expects

concerns.title: Auth failures are logged
concerns.description: Failed auth attempts call `logRequest`; make sure the log line never ends up including the bearer token itself.
